skills.officialDescription: Wraps your target in a swirling torrent of time. Applies Temporal Insanity, causing your target to hit itself instead of you, and Counterstance, reducing your Dodge by 100%. Both effects lasts 6 seconds. If your target is immune to Temporal Insanity, applies Temporal Bubble instead of Counterstance, increasing your Dodge and Damage Resistance by 20% for 12 seconds.
wikiNotes: This skill cannot reduce a target's HP below 1.
Monsters included on this list are immune to the skill.
